title: VUA project-ops command v0.1
description: Project-domain write commands (proposal 014, arbitrated 2026-09-09): project.import-copy is the single write path VUA has toward ALCOM/VCC-managed original projects (product-boundary 1.2.0, user ruling U3) — it creates a NEW project directory as a VUA-managed copy and never touches the original. Two phases in one closed command: phase=plan computes the copy scope (per-entry disk estimate, excluded entries, target path) and a plan digest; phase=apply re-computes the plan, refuses on drift, copies with the exclusions, gives the new project its own identity, records the source link, and re-inspects. Guards are server-side facts evaluated inside the task (target exists / target inside source / source not a registered project / source invalid / insufficient disk space / plan drift); the desktop may pre-hint but the authoritative verdict lives here. Nine-state task semantics (commandId idempotency, cancellable, no implicit resume — a crashed half-copy surfaces inspect_required and retry means the user-triggered clean-then-redo) ride the application-contract task surface, not this schema.
